title: DAY 6 — LESSON 1: TAKING OWNERSHIP OF ASSIGNED DUTIES

questions.prompt: What does taking ownership of assigned duties mean?
options: Doing tasks only when a supervisor is watching
Accepting responsibility, completing duties properly and remaining accountable

questions.prompt: A therapist forgets to prepare her assigned room and says nobody reminded her. What is the main problem?
options: She relied on reminders instead of managing a known responsibility
The receptionist should always do the therapist's work
The appointment should automatically be cancelled

questions.prompt: What should an employee do after discovering a mistake in her work?
options: Acknowledge it, correct what she can and report it when necessary
Taking action within your responsibilities while seeking approval when necessary
Ignoring procedures to finish tasks faster

questions.prompt: What does the OWNER method stand for?
options: Observe, Work, Notice, Ensure, Remain accountable
